job.question: Which retirement plan's investment consulting RFP requires that, as of December 31, 2024, the firm have at least three public fund clients each with at least $1B in assets and have been in business at least ten years?
job.expected_facts: The Retirement Plan for CTA Employees (Chicago Transit Authority), in its April 29, 2025 investment consulting RFP.
job.acceptance: Retirement Plan for CTA/Chicago Transit Authority Employees; publication date is optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System RFP, not an RFP for the Retirement Plan for CTA Employees. Its minimum requirements do not specify three public fund clients each with at least $1B in assets or a firm that has been in business for ten years; the ten-year requirement applies to the lead consultant’s investment experience.
quotes: This RFP is issued by the Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System.
The firm must have at least $2 Billion under management
The firm must work with public pension funds
The lead consultant assigned to this account must have a minimum of 10 years of investment experience
